Plan Enrolment Book an Appointment Book an Appointment for Enrolment or Update Locate Enrolment Centre Search and locate nearby Aadhaar Seva Kendras What is Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK)? 'Aadhaar Seva Kendra' or ASK is a single-stop destination for all Aadhaar services in a comfortable air-conditioned facility. All ASKs are wheelchair friendly and have special provisions to service the elderly and specially abled. More info on ASKs is available here: uidai.gov.in. Where can I find the list of UIDAI ASKs (Aadhaar Seva Kendras)? What services I can avail from Aadhaar Seva Kendra?
